title: Northwind Logistics · Northwind Flow
subtitle: Empathy Map · Dave Gray, XPLANE · research with e-commerce operations managers, October 2026

user: Head of E-commerce Operations, Brightwell Home
9,000 parcels a month, UK and EU buyers
Goal: ship every order on the promised day without her team chasing carriers
says: "Every November I get 300 'where is my order' emails a day."
"I need one carrier for the UK and the EU, not four."
"Our biggest stockist wants carbon per order by March."
thinks: If peak goes badly again, it lands on me
The carbon numbers we publish now are guesses
Switching carrier is risky in the middle of the season
does: Checks four carrier portals every morning
Copies tracking links into support replies by hand
Builds a monthly carbon estimate in a spreadsheet
Upgrades to express at peak just to be safe
feels: Embarrassed when buyers complain in public reviews
Relieved when a delivery date can be promised and kept
pains: Support team overwhelmed on peak days
Parcels stuck at the UK-EU border for days
Carbon figures she cannot defend to auditors
Invoices from four carriers that never reconcile
gains: Buyers who know the half hour their parcel arrives
One contract and one invoice across the UK and EU
Carbon per order she can hand straight to retailers
Fewer than 4 delivery tickets per 1,000 orders
